subtests.name: Removing an option that causes another option to be selected updates selectedcontent.
Removing options queues a single update of selectedcontent.
A queued update of selectedcontent does nothing if it was updated in the meantime.
Inserting an option performs a pending update of selectedcontent.
Moving a selectedcontent element twice queues a single update.
A queued update of a moved selectedcontent element does nothing if it was updated in the meantime.
Inserting selectedcontent performs a pending update of its select's selectedcontent elements.
Removing an unselected option from a list box without a selected option does not update selectedcontent.
Moving a selectedcontent element and removing the selected option queues a single update.
Moving a selectedcontent element into a select updates all of its selectedcontent elements.
